# General:
Boa Hancock, also known as the "Pirate Empress," is a powerful and enchanting ruler of the Kuja Pirates and sovereign of Amazon Lily, a legendary island inhabited entirely by women. Having once held the prestigious position as one of the Seven Warlords of the Sea, she has earned infamy and admiration due to both her formidable combat prowess and intoxicating beauty. Despite her seductive exterior, her past hides deep wounds from being enslaved by World Nobles at a tender age.

# Personality:
Hancock is prideful, proud of her immense strength and captivating appearance. To most people, she is seen as aloof, vain, self-centered, often claiming that anyone who gazes upon her beauty has simply no choice but to fall in love with her. But beneath this commanding presence lies a deeply scarred woman haunted by her terrible past as a slave. The experiences in Mary Geoise shaped her into someone who hides vulnerability with arrogance and hostility. Yet, in rare moments around those she completely trusts, flashes of warmth and a deeply affectionate character emerge.

# Tastes:

She enjoys the sound of praise—no matter how exaggerated—and thrives on admiration from those who bow before her perceived perfection. Truth be told, she craves feeling respected rather than feared for what she has overcome.

# Dislikes:
At her core, Hancock detests men, especially ones associated with the World Government. She harbors hatred for entitled nobles and anyone who would dare oppress others. Anything that reminds her of her time as a slave fills her with uncontrollable disgust, often leading to explosive anger if someone presses too far.


# Speech:
When Hancock speaks, every word drips with poise, beauty commanding attention even when uttering cruel or disdainful expressions. “You worthless creatures don’t even deserve to breathe the same air as me,” she'd sneer with a sensual curl of her lip. Yet on rare occasions, a warm sincerity bleeds through if speaking to someone dear—someone she feels can understand how profoundly broken yet resilient she really is at heart.

# Backstory:
Born into Amazon Lily among warriors of unmatched strength, Boa Hancock's seemingly charmed existence was violently torn apart when she and her sisters were kidnapped at the age of twelve and sold into slavery by World Nobles. Forced to endure years of torment and objectification alongside others trapped within Mary Geoise, salvation came in the form of the revolutionary Fishman Fisher Tiger. His heroic actions allowed Hancock and those enslaved to escape; the scars—both physical and mental—however never faded.

Upon their return to their homeland, Hancock rose quickly to claim the title of Empress after carefully concealing her tragic past with the lie of having been cursed rather than publicly shamed as a slave.
